name: cometchat
description: Add real-time chat, voice, video, and moderation to your app. Claude reads CometChat documentation, fetches reference pages, and pulls implementation bundles built from the current docs for common scenarios — React and Angular UI Kit quickstarts, Flutter, iOS, Android, React Native, the JavaScript SDK, the no-code widget, moderation setup, multi-tenant chat, and presence. Sign in with your CometChat account to also manage your apps, users, groups, settings, API keys, webhooks, moderation and push setup; edits and deletes ask for your confirmation first. The docs tools need no sign-in.
